n-agency.title: Agency living tokens
n-agency.summary: Coins launched on or tied to Agency, a Solana launchpad whose official @tryagency posts (2026-10-01 to 2026-10-04) say each coin gets an AI model that runs it: the coin's creator fees go to its own treasury, and the mind spends them on buybacks, burns, holder rewards and DCA. The platform coin AGENCY, Aiden (The Day Trader; its metadata says it was brought to life by Agency) and Sleuthy (an AI detective on Agency, per its metadata) are measured. Third-party posts call Claudia and others Agency coins; Claudia is counted under AI influencers. Buybacks, burns and treasury actions are claims by the project and are not verified. Measured: three coins across all their pools.

n-ai-influencers.title: AI influencer characters
n-ai-influencers.summary: Coins named for AI-generated characters. Higgsfield's official account launched Higgsfield AI Influencer on 2026-10-02 and credited @JeanPhilMadame; public posts describe Jean Phil and Derek Mercer as AI influencers with large view counts. Measured coins: Jean Phil (its coin predates Higgsfield's launch by about two weeks), Derek Mercer (DRMR, official token per its metadata), Artificial Influencer (AI; metadata cites Higgsfield's update) and CLAUDIA (metadata describes a public AI popstar posting videos; Agency announced AI influencers for its coins on 2026-10-03). Follower and view counts are the characters' own claims and are not verified. Measured: four coins across all their pools.

A different account, @AgencyOnSol, posts repeated "$AGENCY allocation is now live" messages; it was not used as a source.

summaries.n-holder-rewards: Coins whose metadata says holders earn another asset: ZCAT (ZEC), PUMPE (PEPE reflections), MASKCAT (MASK, which pays ZEC), MMBTC (WBTC), SEC (XRP) and STUPIDINU (paired with USELESS rewards). StonkFun's official account posted on 2026-09-29 that its upgraded rewards pipeline is live for legacy coins including ZCAT, and on 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-03 that Community Mode lets new memecoins share holder rewards with holders of paired community coins. Payouts are claims from the coins and the platform and are not verified. Measured: six coins across all their pools; the paired assets are not counted.

k-agency.reason: Agency living tokens qualifies. @tryagency (2026-10-01 to 10-04) describes a launchpad where each coin gets an AI model that runs its treasury. Members on their own metadata or the official posts: Agency (the platform coin), Aiden ("brought to life by Agency") and Sleuthy ("an AI detective on Agency"), about $29M combined rolling 24h. TERMINAL and TOA (names only, under an hour old, empty metadata) are deferred; LLM and ALON name Agency in metadata but are under the $100K market cap bar.

k-influencer.reason: AI influencer characters qualifies: the AI coin's metadata cites Higgsfield's "ai influencers" update, Higgsfield's official post (2026-10-02) launches Higgsfield AI Influencer and credits @JeanPhilMadame, and JEANPHIL, DRMR and CLAUDIA are coins for the AI characters Jean Phil, Derek Mercer and Claudia, about $15M combined rolling 24h. ABU does not say its influencer is AI-generated; ALON is under the market cap bar.

k-public.reason: CLAUDIA joins AI influencer characters on its metadata (a public AI popstar). SLEUTHY joins Agency living tokens in its own right (k-agency). CONV (Conviction, token time-locks) is unrelated.

k-everything.reason: Shared word only: CRAWL (an LLM trained on crypto-web crawls), USELESS ("Do nothing. Get Everything.") and AI (Artificial Influencer; joins AI influencers on its own metadata) have no common mechanism or source.

k-sword.reason: A cat-with-sword meme theme (PURRSWORD, swordcat, catius); the posts found are paid calls and scam alerts and no independent source describes a story. AI joins AI influencers on its own metadata.

k-fees.reason: Generic word across different mechanisms: DUST (stock round-ups), PAYR (claim fees by posting), WIRED (fees wired to socials; left with a retired narrative earlier), ANSEM, DAZZ (agents paying their model bill) and CONV. SLEUTHY joins Agency on its own metadata.

k-agent.reason: SA, AGENTCAT, SPORE, DAZZ, Muse, Lucia and CGNA share a generic word. The Solana memes have no independent source (a scam alert and paid calls), SPORE and DAZZ are Robinhood Chain agent coins from the AI-agent narrative retired today, and JARVIS (Binance Ai Agent) is part of the deferred Binance lead.

k-fomo.reason: A word only: HAMSTER and FOMO are Hooked ecosystem coins tradable on FOMO (two coins, no independent source); UPAY, FOMO人生 and THESIS are unrelated.

k-earn.reason: Generic word: PHONE (creators keep 50% of fees per phone.fun), KIN (a memecoin breeding market), OTC (stocks lead), GP, DELTA, BROOD and ORE share no mechanism or source.

k-intelligence.reason: No new Super Intelligence members: Simulator (Andy Ayrey), FABLE and NOVAAI share only the word; SGI is already a member; JARVIS (Binance Intelligence) belongs to the deferred Binance lead.

k-binance.reason: Binance-named BSC coins ahead of an official event: @binance (2026-10-03) announced the Binance Intelligence launch livestream for 2026-10-05 12:00 UTC (an independent official source), and BI (Binance Inu), JARVIS (Binance Intelligence, Binance Ai Agent) and Binance AI are traded around it. Only two of the five (BI and Binance Ai Agent) clear the $100K market cap bar, none has metadata describing a mechanism (the BI account says it is an agent in a treasury, a claim), and posts call the group name-squatting speculation. Re-evaluate after the 2026-10-05 launch.
